messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning to flip the tenant-routing-override flag for a small burst tonight at 21:00 PT. Who can own smoke checks + rollback readiness?

morgan: I can take primary for smoke. Will run the quick checklist and watch dashboards.

sophia: I can pair with Morgan for the first 15m in case we need to scale back. +1 for 21:00.

jamal: FYI: this affects EU batch jobs only (tenants eu-*) — no frontend change. Estimated impact: short-lived elevated latency for long-seq requests.

kevin: Thanks for the heads-up. Can you paste the rollback command we'll use? Also what metric threshold triggers rollback?

alex: Rollback command (same as deploy playbook):
```bash
rbxctl flags set tenant-routing-override false --env=prod --target=eu
```
Alert thresholds: 5m avg p95 latency > 800ms OR error rate spike > 0.5% above baseline. If either, rollback immediately and ping #oncall.

morgan: I'll run the smoke script below at T+2m and T+10m:
```bash
# smoke.sh
curl -sS "https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?tenant=eu-test" -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" | jq '.ok'
```
Will report results here.

deploy-bot: Scheduled flag flip job created by alex for 2026-03-18T21:00:00-08:00. Job ID: fb-20260318-4301.

sophia: Quick preflight checklist:
- confirm smoke token valid (Morgan)
- verify canary fleet is healthy (Jam)
- have rollback command open in terminal (Kevin)
- escalate path: #oncall + page if thresholds hit (Alex)

jamal: Canary fleet looks green now (all hosts healthy). I've set a short alert on node memory > 80% during the flip.

kevin: I have rollback terminal ready and am @available from 20:45–22:00.

alex: Perfect. Owner map: Morgan (smoke), Jamal (infra/canary), Kevin (rollback), Sophia (observer/metrics). I'll trigger at 21:00 PT and post updates.

morgan: 21:00 — starting flip in 30s...

morgan: flip -> success, traffic shifted to override for 10% of matching tenants :thumbsup:

morgan: smoke T+2m -> OK, response .ok true, p95 ~220ms

sophia: metrics look normal so far, p95 steady, no error spike.

alex: T+10m check: all green. We'll hold for 30m then widen if still stable. Great job team.

kevin: noted — rollback still ready if needed.

morgan: leaving a brief post-run note in Deployments doc and will close job.

deploy-bot: Job fb-20260318-4301 marked complete by morgan at 2026-03-18T21:12:45-08:00.
